summary_1line: Bhishma recounts teachings on rituals pleasing to ancestors and Vishnu, emphasizing reverence to Brahmanas, sacred symbols, vows, and proper conduct in offerings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vishnu smiles while explaining to Indra that his discus, feet, boar form, and dwarf incarnation are the sacred signs people worship on earth.
A blue bull stands at a riverbank, flicking water with its tail and churning mud with its horns as unseen ancestors receive the offering.
A devotee at dawn faces the rising sun after prayer, standing in quiet reverence as golden light spreads across the sky.
